puzzles.name: The Night Flight Cipher
puzzles.description: Scattered fragments of a classified itinerary, hidden across the site.
puzzles.hint: The field kit holds three secrets. One hides near the magnifier, one near the arcade, one near the rogue.

puzzles.name: The Celestial Passport
puzzles.description: Star coordinates hidden across pages form a flight route when combined.
puzzles.hint: Golden glass charts the sky. Three shapes must be drawn before the passport stamps.

puzzles.name: The Grand Key
puzzles.description: The skeleton key constellation — the final challenge.
puzzles.hint: The sky speaks in many frequencies. Master all four lenses to chart the final route.
